title: FoShop
description: GUI economy shops with buying, selling, and rotating boosts.
body:
![FoShop cover image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Fi0CQQOz/images/c167539484d283b2fee8445f66e0bcb46116ebad.png)

FoShop gives server owners a clean GUI economy shop with buying, selling, admin editing, and optional rotating sell boosts in one place. Players get simple shop and sell workflows, while admins can manage sections, products, prices, limits, and migrations without turning the page into a config-only project.

## Shop Menu
- Build organized `/shop` sections with custom icons, descriptions, pages, prices, stock, buy limits, and product types for items, permissions, enchantments, commands, or display-only entries.
- Let players buy the exact amount they need through the amount selector or the built-in Buy More stack preset menu.

![FoShop main shop menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Fi0CQQOz/images/750506cd1c5014fdb1ff80ae3c6c342af41d3c76.png)

## Selling
- Give players fast selling through `/sell`, `/sell all`, `/sell hand`, and `/sellgui`, with unsellable items returned safely.
- Add polished sale feedback with optional hover receipts, titles, action bars, sounds, and SellGUI transaction logs.

![FoShop SellGUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Fi0CQQOz/images/c7513b904c69f0a7d7020d6fa3531c35a8221990.png)

## Rotating Sell Boosts
- Run optional rotating sell boosts through `/rotatingshop`, with configurable reset timing and editor controls for which sections and items can appear.

![FoShop rotating shop](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Fi0CQQOz/images/5d9c3509dcfe6a645f85490f11283f7747bd3453.png)

## Admin Tools
- Manage shop sections, products, settings, rotating-shop pools, reloads, and conversions from `/foshopadmin editor`.

![FoShop admin editor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Fi0CQQOz/images/9fcb631e7ac704df05c2355212f88c21f02108aa.png)

## Dependencies
- `Vault` plus an economy plugin - required for buy and sell payments.
- `PlaceholderAPI` - optional; parses PlaceholderAPI values in configurable shop and GUI text.

## Commands
- `/foshop` or `/shop` - Open the main shop GUI.
- `/sell [all|hand|gui]` - Sell inventory items, hand items, or open the SellGUI.
- `/sellall` - Sell all sellable inventory items.
- `/sellhand` or `/sellheld` - Sell the item in your main hand.
- `/fosellgui` or `/sellgui` - Open the SellGUI directly.
- `/rotatingshop` or `/rshop` - Open the rotating boosted sell shop when enabled.
- `/foshopadmin editor` - Open the in-game admin editor.
- `/foshopadmin reload` - Reload config, messages, GUI files, and shops.
- `/foshopadmin rotatingshop reset` - Pick a new rotating boosted sell set.
- `/foshopadmin convert <ShopGUIPlus|EconomyShopGUI> [dryrun]` - Convert supported shop layouts, with dry-run support.

## Permissions
- `foshop.use` - Allows using `/foshop`.
- `foshop.sellgui.use` - Allows using `/fosellgui` and `/sell gui`.
- `foshop.sellall` - Allows using `/sellall` and `/sell all`.
- `foshop.sellhand` - Allows using `/sellhand` and `/sell hand`.
- `foshop.rotatingshop` - Allows using `/rotatingshop`.
- `foshop.admin` - Allows using `/foshopadmin` and receiving admin update notices.
